api.name: em.oji
api.description: Emoji are ideograms and smileys used in electronic messages and web pages. Emoji exist in various genres.

api.name: .filter.seventyseven
api.description: 1977 effect. As the name suggests, this filter gives you a nostalgic 70’s feel by making photos brighter as well as faded.

api.name: .filter.aden
api.description: Aden is famous for its retro, pastel-y look, which works great if you need to soften harsh lights.

api.name: .filter.amaro
api.description: This filter adds more light to the center of the photo and darkens around the edges.

api.name: .filter.brannan
api.description: Brannan adds high contrast and exposure to your photo, giving it some stylish metallic tint. This photo effect is soft and washed out, like a photo from old granny’s album.

api.name: .filter.brooklyn
api.description: Brooklyn brightens up your image and boosts its yellow tones. Depending on the image, it can give it an ethereal look.

api.name: .filter.chessboard
api.description: Chessboard effect - black and white geometric checkered pattern. Mostly best for backgrounds.

api.name: .filter.clarendon
api.description: Clarendon filter will brighten the highlights found in your photos, while also making the shadows a bit bolder.

api.name: .filter.earlybird
api.description: Earlybird to get a retro “Polaroid” feel with soft faded colors and a hint of yellow.

api.name: .filter.gingham
api.description: Gingham muddy highlights, brightness, a slight haze and a subtle warm up of the tones by carefully applying red and magenta to selected parts of the image.

api.name: .filter.hudson
api.description: Hudson emphasizes light in your image and gives your photos a bluish, colder feel.

api.name: .filter.inkwell
api.description: Inkwell adds high contrast and also makes your photos black and white.
